Implants are one of the most significant developments… READ MORE Preventative Dentistry Preventative dentistry follows good oral hygiene practices to keep your teeth healthy throughout your entire life. Smile & Aesthetics 360’s goal is to keep people’s teeth and gums healthy and avoid oral problems such as gum disease, cavities, enamel wear, and tear, etc. READ MORE Restorative Dentistry ​ Restorative dentistry involves procedures that repair, replace, or maintain a tooth. The restorative procedures are cavity fillings, root canals, and dental implants. Restorative dentistry can have two objectives: restoring the teeth’s function and restoring their appearance.
